description: EventListenerFilter and EventListenerEndpoint are polymorphic on `type`; the converted model keeps only the discriminator, so S.Struct strips the EventNameFilter (`systemEvents`, `userEventPattern`) and EventHubEndpoint (`fullyQualifiedNamespace`, `eventHubName`) payloads on encode and decode. Add the subtype members to the base shapes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: EventNameFilter: matching pattern for user event names (`*`, `event1,event2`, or a single name).
EventHubEndpoint: fully qualified Event Hubs namespace, e.g. `my.servicebus.windows.net`.
EventHubEndpoint: name of the event hub.
